edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) out-ranges your Q at 1200 units and knocks back on a flat 10s cooldown — he pokes and disengages before you can close.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: A second point in Fire Kick (Q) or Cozy Campfire (W) lets him poke and heal the chip straight back — hold your all-in rather than trade into free sustain.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: Your Q slow into E Justice Punch lands hard CC he can't cleanse yet — Breath of Life (R) isn't up until 6, so every landed root sticks.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Warm Hugs (E) only shields, it doesn't stop your dash — keep pressuring his ADC with empowered autos while Fire Kick (Q) is down.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance and his Breath of Life (R) are both team-wide plays, but his R is 160s at rank 1 — your flash-R reaches his backline long before he can answer with it.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: MR and durability blunt his Q/W poke, and Grievous Wounds timing beats Cozy Campfire (W) and Breath of Life (R) sustain before he can reapply it.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: His R cleanses your whole CC chain and his team-wide shields blanket the carry — a lone engage gets undone the moment he R's, so pair Hero's Entrance with your jungler instead of solo-diving.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shield of Durand banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Breath of Life (R) is 160s at rank 1, down to 130s — force it out with a real CC threat before you commit, since it cleanses your whole chain. Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) is a flat 10s at every rank, so respect the poke between your engages.
